core_checks.requirement: Active Jira acceptance criteria are satisfied or explicitly dispositioned by authorized scope change.
The smallest coherent required implementation/deliverable exists and matches the accepted design.
Focused and impacted tests pass; required repository/CI gates pass.
No protected PIT, leakage, identity, judging, or promotion rule was weakened or bypassed.
Security, secret, license, rights, and dependency policies pass.
Requirements, ADR, acceptance, provenance, and Jira/PR traceability are updated where applicable.
No fabricated data, result, metric, threshold, BAS effect, A&M lift, benchmark, or maturity claim exists.
No unexplained staged/unstaged/untracked files remain in the owned worktree.
The PR links Jira/internal IDs, describes scope/risks/evidence/limitations, and has no unresolved review/CI blocker.
Integration is complete through the approved merge path or the non-code outcome has accepted evidence.
Jira reflects the real final state and includes concise completion evidence.
Branch/worktree cleanup is completed or intentionally deferred with ownership.
Known limitations and legitimate follow-up work are recorded without hiding incomplete acceptance.
Rollback/recovery implications are understood for behavior, schema, data, model, or operations changes.

Every material unit has immutable pre-routing evidence; while the assistive plane is not independently proven operational, direct Codex PROJECT_WORK is absent and only bounded pipeline-bootstrap or retained-authority work occurred.

data_source: Source access and rights are verified; immutable raw snapshot/manifests and provenance are recorded; no restricted raw redistribution.
pit_or_feature: Historical known-at eligibility and target-game exclusion pass replay/leakage tests; missingness is not converted into false negative evidence.
model_or_ml: Baseline comparison, chronological evaluation, calibration, protected promotion, reproducibility, and null-result honesty are satisfied.
tamu_or_bas: National no-adjustment baseline remains; cross-fit/peer/regime/null-result rules are followed; no nonzero effect is presumed.
operations_or_release: Observability, backup/restore, freshness, resource benchmark, rollback, and release checklist are satisfied.
assistive_execution: The independent two-hour black-box, 24-hour probation, and seven-day sustained-operation evidence pass; useful downstream-consumed offload and measured net savings are positive; no unjustified Codex fallback or manual packet replenishment occurred.

done_never_means: tests skipped because change looked small
synthetic starter interpreted as production evidence
